The decisive error is in part (1): the total omits the reverse order of each listed pair. With replacement, all four ordered cases qualify:
\[
(R1,B2),\ (B2,R1),\ (R2,B1),\ (B1,R2).
\]
Thus
\[
P=2\left(\frac29\frac29+\frac49\frac19\right)
=\boxed{\frac{16}{81}},
\]
not \(\frac{8}{81}\). For example, drawing red2 followed by blue1 satisfies both conditions but was not counted.

Part (2) is correct. Independently,
\[
P(A)=\frac69=\frac23,\qquad P(B)=\frac39=\frac13,
\]
and
\[
P(A\cap B)=\frac29\frac28+\frac49\frac38
=\frac29=P(A)P(B).
\]
Therefore \(A\) and \(B\) are independent.

**Verified final result:**  
(1) \(\boxed{\frac{16}{81}}\).  
(2) \(\boxed{P(A)=\frac23,\ P(B)=\frac13}\); the events are independent.
